domains: difficulty with close-range judgments of space and distance in real-world tasks (e.g. threading a needle, crossing the road, judging the next stair)
response_scale: 5-point: 5 no difficulty; 4 slight; 3 moderate; 2 severe difficulty/regularly uses sensory substitution; 1 cannot do task because of vision/gets someone else to do it; NA never done/unrelated reasons
scoring: Rasch ability scores in logits (Winsteps, joint maximum likelihood); range -1.58 to 3.41, mean 0.58 (SD 1.24)
target_population: visually impaired adults attending low vision clinics (mainly ARM)
notes: 30 items initially, 28 after deleting items 16 and 25 (p3); text later says 26-item five-point scale (p3, inconsistent); subject reliability 0.95, item reliability 0.94; items 8 and 23 borderline misfit; n=42 small; test-retest not done (p5); all items begin "How much difficulty do you have..."; pages 2, 3, 5
